body:
The optimization looks good for now.

Seeing @KoBeWi 's comment, I think we should implement a few things to improve the state of the editor:
- If we keep the rect, it should likely edit the points instead of the scale.
- If we remove the rect, it would be nice to have multi-points select.

In any case, we would still likely need a way to move the "origin" of the points, as I believe it's a valid use case.
